items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1961-02-10
items.q: They would kill the old brother Jones, his stomach arrest.

ctx.x: Yeah, the funerals. They take the body to the cemetery real slow. Everybody is serious, you know. And after the reverend, say ashes to ashes, dust to dust, you know what I mean? Yeah. They would kill the old brother Jones, his stomach arrest.
And then we go on back playing, didn't he ramble, oh, didn't he ramble.
